question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Abate
solution:
The correct answer is **'Aggravate'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given word **'Abate**' means to become less strong; to make something less strong.(प्रकोप या प्रभाव का कम हो जाना या कम करना; धीमा होना)

 
 
• ***Example***:* ​Zandu pancharishta is a great anecdote to **abate** the digestive issues of the human body.*
 
 
 
• The marked option **'Aggravate'** means to make something worse or more serious( बिगाड़ देना; बदतर करना या होना, अधिक गंभीर बनाना)
 
• From the given meanings of both these words, it is clear that they are **antonyms.**

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3.**
